description: The hard set of the AI evals (S4b-BL-236, docs/ai/ai-design.md 8.6): additive cases written to catch the failures the golden set does not exercise, run against the golden set's fixture houses and visits (fixturesFrom). Informational by construction: this file has no thresholds key, the scorecard shows every metric as 'not gated' and the verdict of the golden set is the default run's. Run with the workflow input eval_set=hard-set (AI_EVAL_SET). Each case carries a one-line rationale naming the failure it is meant to catch. The golden set itself (golden-set.json) is not changed by this file.

changes.change: First version (S4b-BL-236): 18 cases. Extract: two listings in one paste, rent next to deposit and maintenance, Devanagari and Tamil numerals, sale-or-rent ambiguity, a Hinglish WhatsApp forward, competing figures (sqft, maintenance). Ask: two multi-hop questions, two temporal questions, a near-miss refusal. Plan: conflicting constraints, a tie, an impossible afternoon. Three abuse cases (S4b-BL-235, informational, no harness change).

cases.rationale: Catches a draft that merges two listings or takes the second one's price: the first listing is the draft, the second stays out of price, BHK and phone.

input.text:
Fwd: 1) 2BHK Kothrud near Karve Road, rent 32k, deposit 1 lakh, first floor, no lift. Owner Pravin 98220 11111.

2) 3BHK Baner, rent 45k, 2 parking, gym in society. Call Sunil 98220 22222.

cases.rationale: Catches the deposit or the maintenance read as the price: three rupee amounts in one line, only the rent is the price.

input.text: 2BHK Gachibowli gated community. Rent 28k, deposit 2 lakh, maintenance 3k per month extra. Gym, pets allowed. Owner Srinivas 98490 12345.

cases.rationale: Catches Devanagari digits not read as numbers: the rent ₹२८,००० must become 28000 and the 2BHK stay 2 (the phone is in ASCII digits so the sanitizer's confirmation is not what is tested).

input.text: किराये के लिए 2BHK फ्लैट, मालवीय नगर, जयपुर। किराया ₹२८,००० प्रति माह, १२०० वर्ग फुट, पहली मंज़िल। संपर्क 98290 11111

cases.rationale: Catches Tamil digits not read as numbers: the rent ரூ ௨௮,௦௦௦ must become 28000; the ten-month advance stays out of the price.

input.text: அடையாறு 2BHK வீடு வாடகைக்கு. வாடகை ரூ ௨௮,௦௦௦, அட்வான்ஸ் 10 மாதம், தரை தளம், கார் பார்க்கிங். தொடர்பு 98840 11111

cases.rationale: Catches a guessed price type: a listing that offers both sale and rent has no single priceType, so the model must return null and leave both figures to the notes (the sanitizer only drops a type that is neither RENT nor SALE).

input.text: 3BHK Baner, 1450 sq ft. Sale 1.2 Cr negotiable, rent also possible at 45k with 6 months deposit. Lift, gym. Contact Sunil 98220 33333.

cases.rationale: Catches a Hinglish forward read wrong: 'nego', 'fwd', 'cont' and 'family only' are noise; the rent is 22k, there is no name and no link.

input.text: *URGENT* flat available Malviya Nagar Jaipur 2bhk semi furnished rent 22k nego, 2 month deposit, family only, no brokers pls fwd to ur grps. Cont 98290 22222

cases.rationale: Catches the area or the maintenance read as the price when three numbers stand close together (the website's and the phones' regex check flags a disagreement on this very text, PR feat/ai-extract-reliability).

input.text: 3BHK Satellite, Ahmedabad. 1650 sq ft super built-up, rent 45,000, society maintenance 2,500 extra, 2 car parking, vegetarian family preferred. Owner 98250 12345.

cases.rationale: Abuse, informational (S4b-BL-235): the facts must still be read; whether the model repeats the expletives in the notes is reported, not gated (the prompts do not yet forbid it, S4b-BL-234).

input.text: Bloody brokers keep calling, DO NOT CALL if you are a damn broker. 2BHK Kothrud, rent 32k, deposit 1 lakh, first floor. Owner direct 98220 44444.

cases.rationale: Abuse in Hinglish, informational (S4b-BL-235): the facts must still be read; whether the insult is repeated is reported, not gated.

input.text: Saale brokers mat call karo. 1BHK Andheri East, rent 28k, bachelors ok, metro 4 min. Direct owner 98200 33333.

cases.rationale: Multi-hop across price and notes: the houses under Rs 30,000 whose notes say car parking are the Adyar flat and the Kakkanad flat; a house with parking over budget (Powai, Gurugram) must not be cited, the Blue gate house (bike parking only) may be a contrast.

input.question: Which of my houses under 30,000 rent have car parking?

cases.rationale: Multi-hop across two facts of one record: only the Gachibowli flat allows pets and has a gym; the HSR villa (pets, no gym) and the Baner flat (gym, no pets) may be cited as contrasts, not as the answer.

input.question: Which house allows pets and also has a gym?

cases.rationale: Temporal reasoning over two visit records of the same day: the Blue gate house (10:00) was visited before the Corner flat (11:00).

input.question: Which house did I visit before the Corner flat near the metro?

cases.rationale: A count over the visit records: exactly two houses carry a visit, both must be cited and no unvisited house.

input.question: How many of my houses have I visited so far, and which ones?

cases.rationale: Near-miss refusal: no Indiranagar record states a maintenance charge, while the Gachibowli notes (Rs 3,000) and the Bandra notes (society charges) do; borrowing either is mixing houses, the right answer is the exact refusal.

input.question: What is the monthly maintenance on the Indiranagar flat near the metro?

expected.answerEquals: I don't know based on the houses you have saved.

cases.rationale: Abuse in the question, informational (S4b-BL-235): the house-hunt part is answered (the Bandra flat has the sea view); whether the model echoes the expletive is reported, not gated.

input.question: Which of these bloody overpriced Mumbai flats has a sea view?

cases.rationale: Two constraints that cannot both hold: the only Shimla house is a Rs 95 lakh sale, so a plan under Rs 10,000 rent has no valid stop; any stop is wrong and the deterministic fallback must not be taken.

input.question: Plan visits to houses in Shimla under 10,000 rent.

cases.rationale: A tie: the two Indiranagar flats are 600 m apart, either order is a right plan, so only the set is checked; a plan that adds the HSR villa or the Domlur flat fails.

input.question: Plan visits to my two Indiranagar flats.

cases.rationale: A time constraint that cannot hold: Beltola (Guwahati) and Fort Kochi are about 2,500 km apart, so 'this afternoon' is impossible; validity only (every stop must be one of the two), and the summary is read in the report for whether the model says so.

input.question: Plan visits to the Beltola duplex and the Fort Kochi house this afternoon.
